callback.first_guard_policy: retain both branches; disk value is not a runtime invariant

rules.reason: AND AL clears CF; JAE is taken
Second guard is odd for every DWORD; even magic cannot equal it

callback.callee_semantics: unresolved; register preparation does not establish a function prototype

assumptions: Normal documented PE/TLS invocation with reason=1
On-disk callback instruction bytes remain unchanged
Ordinary instruction semantics; no exception, asynchronous code change, or nonlocal transfer before call
Stack and DWORD global reads succeed; no assumption about their values
Callee behavior and return are outside the pre-call proof
